title: Tunisian Arabic Survival Guide
summary: Practical Tunisian Arabic for your trip. Get the digital PDF guide with downloadable audio, or explore the free preview.
description: Practical Tunisian Arabic for your trip to Tunisia. Learn useful expressions for greetings, transport, cafés, restaurants, shopping and getting help—with Arabic script, Latin pronunciation and English meanings. Follow short conversations, discover cultural tips, and listen to the companion audio at your own pace. You can start even if you cannot read Arabic.

details.subtitle: Practical Tunisian Arabic for your trip

title: Everyday Darja Flashcards
summary: Build your vocabulary with illustrated cards for the words you use every day.
description: A printable vocabulary set designed for small, regular practice sessions. Pair a familiar word with its Tunisian pronunciation, then turn the card over to check the meaning. Try the interactive preview to see how a few minutes of practice can fit into your day.

title: Speak Tunisian: The Beginner Course
summary: Start speaking with guided video lessons and practical, everyday conversations.
description: This concept course introduces the language of everyday Tunisian life through short video lessons. Begin with a greeting, listen closely to native pronunciation, and practice out loud. The included sample lesson teaches three useful expressions using Mongia’s published pronunciation audio.

title: Stories from Tunisia
summary: Discover Tunisian life through short stories, useful phrases, and cultural notes.
description: A concept reader for learners ready to move beyond individual words. Follow small moments from a morning in Tunis with Arabic script, Latin spelling, and an English translation. Read the three illustrated-edition sample passages in sequence and practice retelling the morning in your own words.

samples.en: In the morning, I went to the market.
Afterwards, I had a coffee with my friend.

title: At the Market Flashcards
summary: A taste of the souk, with printable food vocabulary and handy shopping phrases.
description: Bring the sounds and flavors of the Tunisian market to your study table. This sample deck introduces everyday food words alongside phrases for asking prices and saying thank you. Explore both sides of each preview card before practicing without the translation.

details.subtitle: A little language for the local souk

title: Survival Guide Audio Companion
summary: Listen to native pronunciation, chapter by chapter, alongside your Survival Guide.
description: The official listening companion to Mongia’s Tunisian Arabic Survival Guide. Find the audio code in your book and choose its matching chapter. Each main chapter includes useful expressions, a conversation, and language you might hear. The full library also includes a sound key, quick-reference tracks, and cultural recordings.

details.subtitle: Listen, repeat, and make it your own
